questions.q_en: Find the difference between the sum of all composite numbers from 41 to 53 and the sum of all prime numbers from 10 to 30.
questions.solution_en:
The composite numbers from 41 to 53 = 42, 44, 45, 46, 48, 49, 50, 51, 52

The sum of all the composite numbers from 41 to 53 = 42 + 44 + 45 + 46 + 48 + 49 + 50 + 51 + 52 = 427

The prime numbers from 10 to 30 = 11, 13, 17, 19, 23, 29

The sum of all the prime numbers from 10 to 30 = 11 + 13 + 17 + 19 + 23 + 29 = 112

Hence, the required difference = 427 - 112 = 315

questions.q_en: What is the circumference of the circle having end points of the diameter are (3,4) and (-11,4)?
questions.solution_en:
As end points of the diameter are given,

Distance between these two end points is the length of the diameter.

Hence,

Diameter = √((3-(-11)2+(4-4)2)

= √(196+0) =14 units.

Circumference = π x Diameter = (22/7) x 14 = 44 units.

questions.q_en: Find the surface area (in cm²) of a cardboard box in the shape of a cuboid whose length is 60 cm, breadth is half its length and height is one-third of its breadth.
questions.solution_en:
Length = 60 cm

Breadth = 60 / 2 = 30 cm

Height = 30 / 3 = 10 cm

Surface area = 2(lb + bh + hl) = 2(60 X 30 + 30 X 10 + 10 X 60) = 2(1800 + 300 + 600) = 2 X 2700 = 5400 cm²

Option (b) is the correct answer

questions.q_en: Two boats M and N travels with speed in still water is 16 km/h and 20 km/h respectively and speed of the stream is 4 km/h, then what is the ratio of distance covered by boat M in 2.5 hours in upstream and 4 hours in downstream together to the distance covered by boat N in 3 hours in downstream and 4 hours in upstream together?
questions.solution_en:
Speed of boat M and N in still water is 16 km/h and 20 km/h respectively

So, Boat M: Upstream speed = (16 - 4) = 12 km/h and downstream speed = 16 + 4 = 20 km/h

And, Boat N: upstream speed = (20 - 4) = 16 km/h and downstream speed = 20 + 4 = 24 km/h

So, required ratio = 2.5 * 12 + 4 * 20 : 3 * 24 + 4 * 16 = 110: 136 = 55: 68

questions.q_en: If (x + 1) and (x - 2) are the factors of 4x2 + Ax + B = 0, then:
questions.solution_en:
Given that (x + 1) and (x - 2) are the factor of 4x2 + Ax + B = 0.

(x + 1) = 0 or x = -1

And

(x - 2) = 0 or x = 2

Put x = -1 in the expression: 4 - A + B = 0

A - B = 4 ... (1)

Put x = 2 in the expression: 16 + 2A + B = 0

2A + B = -16 ... (2)

By solving equations (1) and (2),

A = -4 and B = -8

Therefore, B = 2A.

questions.q_en: A tank contains 600 litres pure coconut oil. When x% quantity from the tank is replaced by mustard oil, then the quantity of coconut oil in the tank becomes 420 litres. If this process is repeated for one more time, then the quantity of mustard oil in the tank becomes -
questions.solution_en:
Initial quantity of coconut oil = 600 litres

When x% quantity from the tank is replaced by mustard oil, then

New quantity of coconut oil = (100 - x)% of 600 = 420

100 - x = 70

x = 30

When x% quantity from the tank is replaced by mustard oil one more time, then

New quantity of coconut oil = (100 - x)% of 420 = (100 - 30)% of 420 = 294 litres

Therefore, new quantity of mustard oil in the mixture = 600 - 294 = 306 litres

Two trains - A and B- having the lengths 195 m and 165 m, respectively, are running in the same direction on parallel lines. If the speed of A and B be 77 km/h and 85 km/h, respectively, what will be the time (in seconds) taken by them to cross each other?
questions.solution_en:
Distance covered by faster train to cross the slower train = Sum of length of both the trains = 195 + 165 = 360 m

Relative speed of faster train with respect to slower train when running in same direction = 85 - 77 = 8 km/h = 20/9 m/s

Time taken by trains to cross each other = 360 ÷ (20/9)

= 360 * (9/20)

= 162 seconds

questions.q_en: Which of the following polynomial is divisible by x+2?
questions.solution_en:
The polynomial which is zero for x =-2 is divisible by x +2

From option (1)

3x3 - 2x2 - x + 1 = 3 (-2)3 -2(-2)2 - (-2) +1

= -24 -8 +2 +1 = -29

This polynomial is not divisible by x +2

From option (2)

-4x3 + 3x2 - 2x + 1 = -4 (-2)3 + 3 (-2)2 - 2 (-2) +1

= 32 + 12 + 4 +1 = 49

This polynomial is not divisible by x+2.

From option (3)

5x3 + 4 x2 + 3x +2 = 5 (-2)3 + 4 (-2)2 - 3(-2) +2

= -40 +16 +6 +2 = -16

So, none of the given polynomial is divisible by x +2.

questions.q_en: A, B and C started a business by investing amounts in the ratio 7: 8: 15 respectively. After 8 months C left. After next 4 months B left. At the end of two-years partnership if the total profit earned by them together is Rs.13440, then what is the share of B in profit?
questions.solution_en:
Let the amount invested by A, B and C are Rs.7a, Rs.8a and Rs.15a respectively.

Partnership period = 2 years = 24 months

Now, profit ratio, A: B: C = (7a * 24): (8a * (8 + 4)): (15a * 8) = 7: 4: 5

Total profit earned = Rs.13440

Therefore, share of B in profit = 13440 * 4/(7 + 4 + 5) = Rs.3360

questions.q_en: If third proportion of 64 and 72 is x and mean proportion of (x + 19) and (7 + 2x) is y, then what is the value of (x + y)?
questions.solution_en:
Given, third proportion of 64 and 72 is x

=> x = (72 * 72)/64

=> x = 81

And mean proportion of (x + 19) and (7 + 2x) is y

=> y = √[(81 + 19)(7 + 2 * 81)]

=> y = √(100 * 169)

=> y = 10 * 13

=> y = 130

Hence, (x + y) = 81 + 130 = 211

questions.q_en: The coefficient of x in (x - 3y)3 is:
questions.solution_en:
We know, (a - b)3 = a3 - b3 - 3ab(a - b)

(x - 3y)3 = x3 - (3y)3 - 3x. 3y(x - 3y)

= x3 - 27y3 - 9xy (x - 3y)

= x3 - 27y3 - 9x2y - 27xy2

questions.q_en: The length of train Y is 60 m more than the length of train Z and speed of train Y and Z is 25 m/s and 30 m/s respectively. If the ratio of time taken by both trains to cross a pole is 3:2 respectively, then find the length of train Z.
questions.solution_en:
Let length of train Z = 'd' meters

Length of train Y = 'd + 60' meters

Now,

[(d + 60)/25]/(d/30) = 3/2

2*6(d + 60) = 3*5d

12d + 720 = 15d

d = 240 m

So, length of train Z = 240 m
